propositions: Rebar reconciler hardcodes Jira project workflow mappings in value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py, preventing support for projects with workflow concepts that lack analogous mappings without core edits.

A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam layered from built-in defaults → config default block → per-project overlay must replace hardcoded maps for status, type, link relations, priority, transitions, and parent relationships.

Non-representable target concepts (missing status, type, transition, parent) must be handled by map, collapse (with rebar-type: label), skip (type-granular exclusion), or drift (with warning), with transitions additionally attempting replay of recorded STATUS event log hops before degrading to drift.
A non-representable parent relationship must drift with an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key.
The mapping core must be provider-neutral with no Jira-specific literals, while Jira-specific defaults and live-probe logic live only in the adapter.
Config load must fail closed on undecided type mappings, and required-field create failures must be prevented by per-project create_defaults blocks.
